Sgr was disrupted on its most recent pericentric passage, ~1 Gyr ago, and that the mass distribution of the Galactic potential is best represented by a disk and bulge mass of 8.5 and 1.0 × 1010 M⊙, respectively, and a dark halo mass of 2.0 × 109M⊙, within a 200 kpc radius.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Sgr stream, as traced by our data and the Law & Majewis model, is consistent with a high value of ΘLSR.
the Sgr stream is a useful probe of the Galactic mass distribution, and that the Sgr dwarf was stripped from the Milky Way on the first pericentric passage, with a pericenter distance of ~15 kpc.
